title: SupervisorEvents
description: Two namespaces that must never be mixed (plan §7.1). Provider namespace: normalized adapter stream events. Engine namespace: authoritative coordinator commits. Adapters translate provider protocols only; they never emit engine events.

name.description: provider: run_started | session_bound | agent_message | tool_activity | usage | provider_retry | run_completed | run_failed. engine: action_committed | decision_created | turn_ended | match_finished.

at.description: Supervisor/engine timestamp. Usage sums must deduplicate by event ID before aggregating (plan §8.3).

sessionId.description: Exact provider-returned session/thread ID. Never 'resume last' or directory heuristics (plan §7.1).

payload.description: Event-specific body. usage carries nullable token counts/cached tokens/durations/retries/provider-reported cost (never fabricated dollars for subscriptions). Unknown provider fields tolerated; unknown engine fields rejected.
